WITH event_ratios AS (
    SELECT
        link_to_event AS event_id,
        SUM(spent) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(amount), 0) AS spend_ratio
    FROM budget
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
with_average AS (
    SELECT
        event_id,
        spend_ratio,
        AVG(spend_ratio) OVER () AS average_spend_ratio
    FROM event_ratios
)
SELECT
    event_id,
    spend_ratio,
    spend_ratio / NULLIF(average_spend_ratio, 0) AS relative_spend_ratio
FROM with_average
ORDER BY relative_spend_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
